$comment: The plan pack's bounds, as data: its budget in characters and how many of each list it says. A pack never cuts the two calls as fill-in JSON of the level (without them a plan takes many more calls to be accepted, which costs more than their characters); files, then assumptions, then decisions are cut before them. With no area a pack of normal work is 3,371 characters when the prompt names no file (the level line, the small form, the calls line, the shapes line, the two calls, each a draft and the call that reads it) and 3,444 with three files named; a small fix is 1,448; each is 52 more where the four draft paths name an AI session's own drafts folder. A prompt naming no file gets the normal layout, so the budget leaves a normal pack about 1,600 characters for the area: the decisions' heading, the line of how a person replaces one (262) and the decisions themselves, because a decision that is cut is asked again.
